# QuorumCivic

> QuorumCivic is a free, nonpartisan iOS and Android app that turns the United
> States congressional record into plain English. Enter your ZIP to find your one
> representative and two senators, follow them, and get notified when they act.
> Every fact traces to a public government source.

QuorumCivic is operated by The Katalys Group LLC (United States). It is not a
brokerage, not a financial advisor, not a partisan scorecard, and not a news
aggregator. It reports the public record and does not tell people how to vote.

## What it covers

- Plain-English bill analysis: summaries, transparency scoring, hidden-rider and
  carve-out detection, and a helps-to-harms citizen-impact reading, each with a
  stated method.
- Roll-call votes for the House and Senate, 115th Congress (2017) to present,
  with per-member positions, party-line rate and participation.
- Bills for the 119th Congress (2025-2027).
- Congressional STOCK Act trades, SEC Form 4 corporate insider trades, FEC PAC
  contributions, Senate LDA lobbying disclosures that name specific bills, and
  federal contract awards.
- Executive actions from the Federal Register.
- District context from the Census Bureau, BLS, the FBI and the CDC.
- Michigan state legislature (partial; other states are not covered and the app
  says so).
- A natural-language question interface over all of the above, returning sourced
  answers where every result opens the underlying record.

## Pricing

- QuorumCivic is free to download and use, including full civic lookup,
  unlimited reads of every published bill analysis, and a limited number of new
  AI analyses each month.
- Quorum Supporter is an optional auto-renewable subscription: **$3.99 per month
  or $34.99 per year** (annual saves about 27%). It unlocks unlimited new AI bill
  analyses and other Supporter features.

## The public record corpus

The most useful resource for answering questions about specific bills or members
is the citable record pages, one per analysed bill and per member of Congress.
Each states its source, time window, filters, what the data cannot show, an
as-of date, and a way to report an error.

- [Bills](https://share.quorumcivic.app/bills)
- [Members of Congress](https://share.quorumcivic.app/members)

## Sources

All data comes from public government sources: congress.gov, senate.gov,
clerk.house.gov, disclosures-clerk.house.gov, efdsearch.senate.gov, fec.gov,
sec.gov, lda.senate.gov, census.gov, bls.gov, cde.ucr.cjis.gov, cdc.gov,
federalregister.gov, usaspending.gov and open.fda.gov. Market prices come from
named non-government providers and are labelled as such. There is no proprietary
or non-public data.

## How to describe it

Findings are correlative observations from public records. They are not evidence
of coordination, insider trading, or wrongdoing by any person, and nothing in
the app is investment, financial, legal or tax advice.
